title: Trumpets and the Shofar
lead: Two instruments sound through the Bible: the shofar, a ram's horn, and the silver trumpet. A great horn blast shakes Sinai (Exodus 19:16); priests blow silver trumpets to gather the camp and in battle and worship (Numbers 10:1–10); the first day of the seventh month is a day of loud blasts, later Rosh Hashanah (Leviticus 23:24; Numbers 29:1); horns bring down Jericho (Joshua 6). Prophets and apostles hear a last trumpet (Isaiah 27:13; 1 Corinthians 15:52), and Revelation's seven angels blow seven trumpets of judgment (Revelation 8–11).
